title: Reproducible search protocol: flotation-froth bubble segmentation review

databases.OpenAlex: https://api.openalex.org/works?search=<query>&filter=publication_year:1995-2026&per-page=100 (OpenAlex "search" matches title, abstract and indexed full text; relevance-ranked)
databases.Crossref: https://api.crossref.org/works?query=<query>&filter=from-pub-date:1995&rows=100 (bibliographic relevance query; total-results counts every record matching any query term, so totals are not precision-meaningful)

screening_depth: Top 100 relevance-ranked records per query per database were exported and screened (fewer when the database returned fewer). This exceeds the minimum of 50 per query.
inclusion_criteria: (2) method delineates bubbles or measures bubble size/count from images (segmentation, edge detection, instance detection, size/count estimation)
(3) peer-reviewed journal/conference paper or thesis, 1995-2026, English or with English abstract
exclusion_criteria: pure froth classification / grade or condition prediction without bubble delineation
non-flotation bubbles or pulp-phase / bubble-column bubble imaging
reviews, patents, abstract digests, book/encyclopedia entries, peer-review reports
bubble size used only as an input variable to control/process studies with no delineation method described or evaluated (operationalisation of criterion 2)

records_identified_other_sources.note: existing corpus items not hit by the searches: Moolman1995, Lin2008, StoneThree2019 patent, three IEEE DataPort datasets, Barhoun2022, Namdari2022, Huang2023, Lu2024, Prokopov2024 Kaggle dataset. Supplementary items: daSilva2021 (UFOP), Wu2019 (CMC), EstradaRuiz2009 (JSAIMM), Popli2017 thesis, Zatonskiy2023 (SUSU), IEEE Access 2020 5G foam system, SSRN 2025 static foam U-Net/Hough, Wu et al. 2017 MTAP (citation).

full_text_sought_new_studies.note: sought = eligible new studies flagged open access by OpenAlex/publisher; database: 16,206,487,135,234,306,444,445 retrieved + 237,274,394,221,312,472,477,45 not retrieved (indices into the screened candidate list); supplementary: daSilva2021, Wu2019, EstradaRuiz2009, Popli2017, Zatonskiy2023 retrieved; IEEE Access 2020 5G and SSRN 2025 not retrieved
